title: Noise stability and agreement probability
statement: Let $\Omega$ and $\beta$ be finite sets, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, let $\rho\in[0,1]$, and let $f:\Omega^n\to\beta$. Under the product distribution with marginal $\pi$, the expected inner product of the probability-simplex vectors representing the labels of an input and its independently coordinate-noised version equals the probability that the two labels agree.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
